description: A four-item multiple-choice achievement test developed by Filiz Tuba Dikkartin Övez to measure tenth-grade students' learning of four quadratic-functions acquisitions.
title: Quadratic Functions achievement test

description: A statewide quality rating and improvement framework run through a collaboration among First 5 California, the California Department of Education, and the California Department of Social Services to assess and support early-learning and care sites.
title: Quality Counts California (QCC)

description: A structured small-group language-arts discussion framework developed by Quality Talk researchers that uses authentic questions, reasoning, co-constructed responses, teacher talk moves, and gradual transfer of discussion control to students.
title: Quality Talk (QT)

description: QTEL is a professional-development and instructional programme that supports educators in teaching rigorous academic content and academic English simultaneously to secondary English Learners.
title: Quality Teaching for English Learners (QTEL)

description: QELP is a multi-component pharmacology experimental-course assessment developed and administered by the college's Experimental (Training) Teaching Center to combine online, midterm, experimental-report, and final scores.
title: Quantitative evaluation of learning process (QELP) instrument

description: The QRC is a modifiable computer game created by Vongehr for teaching quantum mechanics through challenges involving quantum and hidden-variable simulations.
title: Quantum Randi Challenge (QRC)

description: A branded instructional framework that orchestrates classroom context and content through an engaging sequence of enrollment, experience, demonstration, reflection, repetition, and celebration, developed for adoption by teachers.
title: Quantum Teaching Strategy

description: A 30-item quantum-theory achievement test developed by Saif Alneyadi et al.
title: Quantum Theory Test

description: An interactive PhET physics simulation that lets learners manipulate potential and energy while viewing wave-packet tunneling and multiple wave-function representations.
title: Quantum Tunneling and Wave Packets simulation (PhET)

description: Carnegie Math Pathways developed these one-term college-level quantitative-reasoning and statistics course sets with embedded developmental corequisite support for colleges serving students placed into developmental mathematics.
title: Quantway College with Corequisite and Statway College with Corequisite one-term course sets

description: A whole-year-group Key Stage 3 English literacy programme adapted and delivered by Success for All (UK) and coordinated by the SfA Foundation.
title: Quest whole-year-group Key Stage 3 literacy programme

description: Question Pot is a custom generative-AI chatbot agent built and deployed by Dai et al.
title: Question Pot

description: Questionmark's Perception is an assessment-delivery and reporting platform made by Questionmark for administering online tests, formative evaluations, feedback, and performance analysis.
title: Questionmark's Perception (QMP)

description: A three-part online questionnaire battery combining measures of lighting, noise and temperature, technology adequacy for online learning, psychological distress, sociodemographics, and verified academic performance, used by the study researchers with undergraduate medical students.
title: Questionnaire battery: LNT scale, technology scale, and GHQ-12 with verified GPA

description: The QIWB is Rose's 24-item self-report questionnaire assessing writer's block across five subscales: blocking, lateness, premature editing, strategies for complexity, and attitudes.
title: Questionnaire for Identifying Writer's Block (QIWB)

description: Igor Korsun's ten-item yes/no physics questionnaire measures secondary learners' motivational cognitive activity by scoring their reported physics knowledge, interests, and engagement with additional resources.
title: Questionnaire measuring the motivational component of learners' cognitive activity

description: The QVP is an 18-item-plus-background-questionnaire developed by Mårtensson et al.
title: Questionnaire Virtual Patient (QVP) instrument

description: QUESTOURnament is a Moodle module made for organizing time-constrained academic challenges in which learners answer, submit, and assess questions while earning dynamically varying points and rankings.
title: QUESTOURnament

description: A 10-item multiple-choice instrument developed by Jenny Mirjam Annina et al.
title: Quick Risk Test

description: A school-based Transcendental Meditation programme delivered and supervised by certified TM teachers, with supported daily practice for pupils.
title: Quiet Time Transcendental Meditation program

description: A healthcare-improvement framework organized around patient experience, provider experience, cost reduction, population health, and health equity, adapted by Rees et al.
title: Quintuple Aim

description: Quipper School is a web-based learning-management platform operated by Quipper that provides OER-based multimedia materials, class management, teacher–student communication, and blended-learning support.
title: Quipper School

description: Quizbot is a multi-tablet gamified quiz system developed by García Sanjuan et al.
title: Quizbot

description: Quizzical is an LTI-compliant online multiple-choice-question authoring, learning, and self-assessment application developed for integration with learning management systems.
title: Quizzical
